# SD-24 Epic 5 (criterion 5.1) deterministic Human Fighter 4 / Wizard 1
# multiclass split-transition fixture.
#
# Represents the exact "split-class transition" the criterion's own RED
# description names: a character that advanced levels 1-4 as a solo Fighter,
# then took its first Wizard level at total character level 5 (Fighter 4 /
# Wizard 1). It names selections only; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values.
#
# Built by combining the already-accepted deterministic Fighter feat/choice
# posture (`pf1_human_fighter_level4_sd13_deterministic_input.txt`'s own
# level-2/level-4 bonus-feat selections) with the already-accepted
# deterministic Wizard school-specialization posture
# (`pf1_human_wizard_level1_sd13_deterministic_input.txt`'s own canonical
# Evocation-specialist / Necromancy-and-Transmutation-opposed selections),
# under a single consistent ability-score array (the Fighter fixture's own
# scores, since Fighter is the majority class here) rather than re-deriving
# either posture. The character's own single `feat:dodge` selection already
# covers Wizard's Scribe Scroll grant's own free-standing recognition (Scribe
# Scroll is not itself a chosen `feat=` selection anywhere in this codebase's
# grounding -- it is an unconditional recognition once Wizard's own level
# gate is met, per `pilot_compute.rs`'s own `explain_wizard_level1_prepared_spell_baseline`).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-fighter4-wizard1-sd24-multiclass-split
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:fighter:4
class_level=class:wizard:1
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
feat=feat:dodge
feat=feat:weapon_focus
feat=feat:toughness
feat=feat:cleave
skill=skill:climb:1
skill=skill:intimidate:1
skill=skill:swim:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
equipment=power_attack:selected_inactive
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat:feat:weapon_focus:weapon:longsword
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_2:feat:toughness
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_4:feat:cleave
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
provenance=docs/release/SD-24-beta-readiness-and-multiclass/epic-breakdown.md#criterion-5.1
